openclash_core.note: Independent regular file; never linked to Nikki /usr/bin/mihomo or /usr/libexec/mihomo.

store.note: Git commit/content-addressed objects pin run/arm64 inputs; SHA256 of every staged file is recorded before extraction. Store UI is optional, but this repository also supplies the retained PassWall/MosDNS/Lucky/Bandix/Amlogic packages.

reproducibility_gaps: ImmortalWrt and third-party dependency feeds are resolved at build time, then their indexes and cached IPKs are hashed and validated; they are not pre-locked here.
Store run/arm64 is pinned by Git commit; its extracted package hashes are recorded, but runtime scripts and transitive feed dependencies are not exhaustively pre-locked.
Docker tag is resolved to an image ID per build and recorded; packaging action/kernel/prebuilt-rootfs inputs are not fully pre-locked.
This is an auditable input manifest, not a claim of bit-for-bit reproducibility.
